text: Most of the week's behaviour changes were fixes in BCApps. VAT and posting fixes include #13085 and #12982 for the VAT product posting group regression seen since 28.4, #12813 for GB reverse charge sales posting, #11998 for a missing General Posting Setup check, and #12201 for non-deductible VAT on foreign-currency projects. Cost and inventory fixes cover #12868 (Adjust Cost rounding variance), #12690 (serial number error when reversing capacity entries) and #12842 (false "Nothing to handle" on warehouse picks). Subscription Billing got #10444, #12967, #12767 and #10477, and Subcontracting got #12783, #11665, #12584 and #12986. New features include credit memo recognition from PDFs in the Payables Agent (#12894) and E-Documents (#12855), Expense Agent alternate approvers (#11955) and enforced itemization (#12599), and French accelerated depreciation moving into the W1 base application (#12160). #9104 moves the XML G/L export onto the Audit File Export framework. AL-Go added GitHub Enterprise Cloud data residency support (#2407) and a built-in Copilot review (#2402). Extensibility changes are #10384 and #13075. #12443 renumbers ES SII objects, and #9143 moves French sales specifics into a new Sales FR app. BCQuality added many knowledge articles.

issues: Subscription Billing (#10444, #12967, #12767, #10477), Subcontracting (#12783, #11665, #12584, #12986) and extensibility (#10384, #13075) pull requests are listed as bare numbers with no description, which makes them less useful to the reader.
AL-Go #2413 (automatic Copilot review triggers only run when opted in) goes with #2402 but is not mentioned.
Several notable behaviour fixes are left out, such as #12149 (only one PDF when printing several reminders), #12943 (DK VAT return periods) and #12561 (Shopify tax rate conflict). This is optional.
